hierarchy_and_scope_notes.scope_notes: No term definition or scope note is exposed in the PQDT browse dialog.
hierarchy_and_scope_notes.qualifiers: No PQDT subject qualifier, major-topic, or focus indicator is exposed.

explosion_focus_major_topic.known_item_effect: An exact subject clause retrieves the selected label only in the bounded check; no default hierarchy expansion is claimed.

browse_vs_result_facet.result_facet: The Results page Subject facet is a result-set refinement, not a vocabulary release or hierarchy; its counts/availability are query- and tenant-dependent.
browse_vs_result_facet.equivalence: not_proven; do not substitute a result facet label for a browsed subject term or term ID.

browse_vs_result_facet.result_facet: The Results page Index term (keyword) facet is a result-set refinement; it is not a released synonym table or hierarchy.

exact_query_syntax.raw_query_policy: Pass raw source syntax unchanged; the current typed --index-term option adds IF(value) and does not claim controlled-term validation or expansion.

live_contrasts.scope: ProQuest Dissertations & Theses Global only; the original selected database was restored after the bounded checks.

product_route_differences.pqdt: The current PQDT Advanced route exposes separate Look up Subjects and Look up Index terms (keywords) browse dialogs with counts. It does not expose the top-level Thesaurus link observed on ATAI.
product_route_differences.atai: ATAI exposes a top-level Thesaurus route and the Technology Thesaurus, whose terms have a rendered narrower-term hierarchy; its results and field totals are a different corpus.
product_route_differences.non_portability: The same display phrase, field code, or numeric document ID must not be used as evidence that the two product vocabularies are interchangeable.

controlled_vocabulary.browse_vs_facets: Browse indexes are source vocabulary/index surfaces; result facets are query-scoped refinements. Neither surface currently supplies stable term IDs.

subject_heading.interpretation: The known record is retrievable by the exact observed subject label and not by the contrasted label. This is an exact-membership check, not evidence of an unobserved hierarchy.

unresolved: No PQDT vocabulary edition, stable term identifiers, preferred-term/synonym table, scope-note export, maintainer, or update cadence is published by the current official route.
PQDT Subject heading and Index term browse lists are flat and expose no hierarchy, Explode, Focus, or Major-topic state; absence in the UI is not evidence that an unexposed back-end expansion exists.
The current UI's browse counts are not permanent totals, and the relationship between every displayed Subject label and the PSUB/MAINSUBJECT aliases is not exhaustively documented.
Index-term case/spelling variants are observed source labels, not safe synonyms; no automatic synonym or plural expansion is claimed for either field.
Result facets, field codes, ProQuest document IDs, and per-request checkbox/form values are not vocabulary term IDs and are never substituted for them.

version.note: The current first-party help and rendered PQDT UI publish no vocabulary edition, snapshot, or last-updated value. The validation date is an observation date, not a vocabulary version.

governance_update_cadence.owner: ProQuest (part of Clarivate), as branded by the current service
governance_update_cadence.assignment: The official help says database editors use associated thesauri to assign subject headings in databases generally; it does not identify a PQDT editor, policy, or schedule.

searchable_fields.scope: The current PQDT form's Subject heading browse is narrower than the All subjects & indexing field; no unqualified-field equivalence is assumed.

preferred_terms_and_synonyms.preferred_marker: none in the current browse list or Add to search control
preferred_terms_and_synonyms.case_behavior: The subject browse rendered labels in lower case in the bounded result; this is display evidence, not a canonical spelling or synonym rule.

hierarchy_and_scope_notes.hierarchy: No broader, narrower, or related links are shown. Results are a flat alphabetic list with A-Z ranges and 100-entry paging.
hierarchy_and_scope_notes.scope_notes: No term definition or scope note is exposed in the PQDT browse dialog.
hierarchy_and_scope_notes.qualifiers: No PQDT subject qualifier, major-topic, or focus indicator is exposed.

term_identifiers.dynamic_values_omitted: The browse checkboxes and hidden form state use per-request dynamic values; they are not term identifiers and are not retained.

explosion_focus_major_topic.explosion: not_exposed; the current flat browse has no descendants to select and no Explode control
explosion_focus_major_topic.known_item_effect: An exact subject clause retrieves the selected label only in the bounded check; no default hierarchy expansion is claimed.

browse_vs_result_facet.browse_index: Look up Subjects is a corpus browse/index surface with displayed term counts and exact-term selection.
browse_vs_result_facet.result_facet: The Results page Subject facet is a result-set refinement, not a vocabulary release or hierarchy; its counts/availability are query- and tenant-dependent.
browse_vs_result_facet.equivalence: not_proven; do not substitute a result facet label for a browsed subject term or term ID.

exact_query_syntax.literal_field: PSUB(aerospace engineering) is accepted but is not exact in the observed contrast.
exact_query_syntax.raw_query_policy: Pass raw Command Line syntax unchanged; the current typed --subject option adds a field restriction but does not validate a vocabulary release, synonym, or hierarchy.

known_item_effect.interpretation: The known record is retrievable by the exact observed subject label and not by the contrasted label. This is an exact-membership check, not evidence of an unobserved hierarchy.

index_terms.name: PQDT Global Index terms (keywords)
index_terms.kind: A product/database browse index of indexed keyword strings; the current PQDT evidence does not establish it as a controlled thesaurus.

version.note: No current first-party release, editorial snapshot, or update cadence is published for PQDT index terms.

governance_update_cadence.owner: ProQuest (part of Clarivate), as branded by the current service
governance_update_cadence.assignment: The current UI exposes indexed keyword strings but does not say whether each is author-supplied, editor-assigned, or normalized by a named vocabulary.

searchable_fields.scope: This field is separate from Subject heading (all); SUBJECT is the broader all-subjects/indexing field.

preferred_terms_and_synonyms.interpretation: Different case, spelling, and near-duplicate labels appear in the browse list; they must not be collapsed into synonyms without source evidence.

hierarchy_and_scope_notes.hierarchy: Flat alphabetic browse pages only; no broader/narrower/related structure is displayed.
hierarchy_and_scope_notes.scope_notes: No keyword definition or scope note is displayed.

term_identifiers.dynamic_values_omitted: Per-request selection and hidden form values are not vocabulary identifiers.

explosion_focus_major_topic.explosion: not applicable/not exposed; no hierarchy or Explode control

browse_vs_result_facet.browse_index: Look up Index terms (keywords) lists indexed strings and counts for the selected PQDT scope.
browse_vs_result_facet.result_facet: The Results page Index term (keyword) facet is a result-set refinement; it is not a released synonym table or hierarchy.

exact_query_syntax.raw_query_policy: Pass raw source syntax unchanged; the current typed --index-term option adds IF(value) and does not claim controlled-term validation or expansion.

live_contrasts.scope: ProQuest Dissertations & Theses Global only; the original selected database was restored after the bounded checks.

subject_browse.count_note: The UI footnote says counts can differ from actual results because duplicate results and punctuation variances are ignored.

index_term_browse.interpretation: Case/spelling variants and near-duplicate author/index labels are visible as separate browse entries; no preferred-label or synonym relation is exposed.

subject_unquoted.interpretation: The unquoted field expression is not the exact browse-term retrieval; use the source EXACT form when the selected term is intended.

all_subjects_and_indexing.interpretation: SUBJECT is broader than the subject-heading browse field and should not be reported as the PQDT subject vocabulary itself.

subject_heading.interpretation: The known record is retrievable by the exact observed subject label and not by the contrasted label. This is an exact-membership check, not evidence of an unobserved hierarchy.

ui_add_to_search.command_line_equivalent: MAINSUBJECT.EXACT("aerospace engineering") or PSUB.EXACT("aerospace engineering") for the subject heading; IF.EXACT("Aerospace engineering") or DISKW.EXACT("Aerospace engineering") for the index term.

product_route_differences.pqdt: The current PQDT Advanced route exposes separate Look up Subjects and Look up Index terms (keywords) browse dialogs with counts. It does not expose the top-level Thesaurus link observed on ATAI.
product_route_differences.atai: ATAI exposes a top-level Thesaurus route and the Technology Thesaurus, whose terms have a rendered narrower-term hierarchy; its results and field totals are a different corpus.
product_route_differences.non_portability: The same display phrase, field code, or numeric document ID must not be used as evidence that the two product vocabularies are interchangeable.

controlled_vocabulary.browse_vs_facets: Browse indexes are source vocabulary/index surfaces; result facets are query-scoped refinements. Neither surface currently supplies stable term IDs.

subject_heading.interpretation: The known record is retrievable by the exact observed subject label and not by the contrasted label. This is an exact-membership check, not evidence of an unobserved hierarchy.

unresolved: No PQDT vocabulary edition, stable term identifiers, preferred-term/synonym table, scope-note export, maintainer, or update cadence is published by the current official route.
PQDT Subject heading and Index term browse lists are flat and expose no hierarchy, Explode, Focus, or Major-topic state; absence in the UI is not evidence that an unexposed back-end expansion exists.
The current UI's browse counts are not permanent totals, and the relationship between every displayed Subject label and the PSUB/MAINSUBJECT aliases is not exhaustively documented.
Index-term case/spelling variants are observed source labels, not safe synonyms; no automatic synonym or plural expansion is claimed for either field.
Result facets, field codes, ProQuest document IDs, and per-request checkbox/form values are not vocabulary term IDs and are never substituted for them.

version.note: The current first-party help and rendered PQDT UI publish no vocabulary edition, snapshot, or last-updated value. The validation date is an observation date, not a vocabulary version.

governance_update_cadence.owner: ProQuest (part of Clarivate), as branded by the current service
governance_update_cadence.assignment: The official help says database editors use associated thesauri to assign subject headings in databases generally; it does not identify a PQDT editor, policy, or schedule.

searchable_fields.scope: The current PQDT form's Subject heading browse is narrower than the All subjects & indexing field; no unqualified-field equivalence is assumed.

preferred_terms_and_synonyms.preferred_marker: none in the current browse list or Add to search control
preferred_terms_and_synonyms.case_behavior: The subject browse rendered labels in lower case in the bounded result; this is display evidence, not a canonical spelling or synonym rule.

hierarchy_and_scope_notes.hierarchy: No broader, narrower, or related links are shown. Results are a flat alphabetic list with A-Z ranges and 100-entry paging.
hierarchy_and_scope_notes.scope_notes: No term definition or scope note is exposed in the PQDT browse dialog.
hierarchy_and_scope_notes.qualifiers: No PQDT subject qualifier, major-topic, or focus indicator is exposed.

term_identifiers.dynamic_values_omitted: The browse checkboxes and hidden form state use per-request dynamic values; they are not term identifiers and are not retained.

explosion_focus_major_topic.explosion: not_exposed; the current flat browse has no descendants to select and no Explode control
explosion_focus_major_topic.known_item_effect: An exact subject clause retrieves the selected label only in the bounded check; no default hierarchy expansion is claimed.

browse_vs_result_facet.browse_index: Look up Subjects is a corpus browse/index surface with displayed term counts and exact-term selection.
browse_vs_result_facet.result_facet: The Results page Subject facet is a result-set refinement, not a vocabulary release or hierarchy; its counts/availability are query- and tenant-dependent.
browse_vs_result_facet.equivalence: not_proven; do not substitute a result facet label for a browsed subject term or term ID.

exact_query_syntax.raw_query_policy: Pass raw Command Line syntax unchanged; the current typed --subject option adds a field restriction but does not validate a vocabulary release, synonym, or hierarchy.

searchable_fields.scope: This field is separate from Subject heading (all); SUBJECT is the broader all-subjects/indexing field.

preferred_terms_and_synonyms.interpretation: Different case, spelling, and near-duplicate labels appear in the browse list; they must not be collapsed into synonyms without source evidence.

hierarchy_and_scope_notes.hierarchy: Flat alphabetic browse pages only; no broader/narrower/related structure is displayed.
hierarchy_and_scope_notes.scope_notes: No keyword definition or scope note is displayed.

term_identifiers.dynamic_values_omitted: Per-request selection and hidden form values are not vocabulary identifiers.

explosion_focus_major_topic.explosion: not applicable/not exposed; no hierarchy or Explode control

browse_vs_result_facet.result_facet: The Results page Index term (keyword) facet is a result-set refinement; it is not a released synonym table or hierarchy.

exact_query_syntax.raw_query_policy: Pass raw source syntax unchanged; the current typed --index-term option adds IF(value) and does not claim controlled-term validation or expansion.

live_contrasts.scope: ProQuest Dissertations & Theses Global only; the original selected database was restored after the bounded checks.

subject_browse.count_note: The UI footnote says counts can differ from actual results because duplicate results and punctuation variances are ignored.

index_term_browse.interpretation: Case/spelling variants and near-duplicate author/index labels are visible as separate browse entries; no preferred-label or synonym relation is exposed.

subject_unquoted.interpretation: The unquoted field expression is not the exact browse-term retrieval; use the source EXACT form when the selected term is intended.

all_subjects_and_indexing.interpretation: SUBJECT is broader than the subject-heading browse field and should not be reported as the PQDT subject vocabulary itself.

ui_add_to_search.command_line_equivalent: MAINSUBJECT.EXACT("aerospace engineering") or PSUB.EXACT("aerospace engineering") for the subject heading; IF.EXACT("Aerospace engineering") or DISKW.EXACT("Aerospace engineering") for the index term.

product_route_differences.pqdt: The current PQDT Advanced route exposes separate Look up Subjects and Look up Index terms (keywords) browse dialogs with counts. It does not expose the top-level Thesaurus link observed on ATAI.
product_route_differences.atai: ATAI exposes a top-level Thesaurus route and the Technology Thesaurus, whose terms have a rendered narrower-term hierarchy; its results and field totals are a different corpus.
product_route_differences.non_portability: The same display phrase, field code, or numeric document ID must not be used as evidence that the two product vocabularies are interchangeable.

controlled_vocabulary.browse_vs_facets: Browse indexes are source vocabulary/index surfaces; result facets are query-scoped refinements. Neither surface currently supplies stable term IDs.

subject_heading.interpretation: The known record is retrievable by the exact observed subject label and not by the contrasted label. This is an exact-membership check, not evidence of an unobserved hierarchy.

unresolved: No PQDT vocabulary edition, stable term identifiers, preferred-term/synonym table, scope-note export, maintainer, or update cadence is published by the current official route.
PQDT Subject heading and Index term browse lists are flat and expose no hierarchy, Explode, Focus, or Major-topic state; absence in the UI is not evidence that an unexposed back-end expansion exists.
The current UI's browse counts are not permanent totals, and the relationship between every displayed Subject label and the PSUB/MAINSUBJECT aliases is not exhaustively documented.
Index-term case/spelling variants are observed source labels, not safe synonyms; no automatic synonym or plural expansion is claimed for either field.
Result facets, field codes, ProQuest document IDs, and per-request checkbox/form values are not vocabulary term IDs and are never substituted for them.
